title: Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.20334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) models are often trained on nominal data using average-risk objectives, which emphasize dominant normal patterns. However, real time series can contain rare but valid nominal regimes that are underrepresented in the training distribution. We show that data-space flow matching can over-penalize such rare-normal windows and assign them anomaly scores comparable to those of true anomalies. To address this, we propose Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching (RT-FM), an unsupervised framework that uses a temporal variational autoencoder to estimate residual latent tailness and converts it into bounded, warmup-annealed weights for training a data-space flow matching model. Experiments on seven TSAD benchmarks show that RT-FM improves rare-normal coverage while preserving strong anomaly discrimination, substantially reducing false alarms on such windows and resulting in improved aggregate detection performanc

translated_title: 基于残差尾部信息的流匹配时间序列异常检测
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）模型通常使用平均风险目标在正常数据上进行训练，这类目标侧重于占主导地位的正常模式。然而，真实时间序列中可能包含在训练分布中代表性不足的稀有但有效的正常状态。我们证明，数据空间的流匹配可能会过度惩罚这类稀有正常窗口，并赋予它们与真正异常相当的异常分数。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了残差尾部信息流匹配（RT-FM），这是一个无监督框架，它使用时序变分自编码器来估计残差潜在尾部性，并将其转换为有界的、预热潮退的权重，用于训练数据空间的流匹配模型。在七个TSAD基准上的实验表明，RT-FM在保持强大异常判别能力的同时，提高了对稀有正常模式的覆盖，显著减少了此类窗口上的误报，从而提升了整体检测性能。
tldr: 提出RT-FM无监督框架，利用时序变分自编码器估计残差潜在尾部性并转化为有界预热潮退权重来引导流匹配训练，避免过度惩罚稀有正常窗口，从而减少误报并提升时间序列异常检测的整体性能。
en_tdlr: RT-FM is an unsupervised framework that uses a temporal VAE to estimate residual latent tailness and convert it into bounded, warmup-annealed weights for flow matching training, preventing over-penalization of rare-normal windows and improving overall time series anomaly detection performance with fewer false alarms.
